notes: PLEA test run 8.5 on Sepolia (chain 11155111): the final code rehearsed once more, with a lighter default build (the test suite in test/full/). Run 7's code (testnet7 @ e1755aa, live as launch #1843: letters without the 0.35 IMD auto-sell fee, LetterTooLong(bytes, 280), the 1.2x seat multiplier read from Seasons' fourth argument with a gas-capped staticcall, the 15-day cap ratchet, PleaDistributor Ownable2Step) plus IMD's run-7 CabalGate size refactor, the two fixes of run 7's launch audit (the Letterbox delivery floor after the hook's sale fees; Tribunal.standing checks the seller's exclusion first), the fixes of audit rounds 5-8 (exact profit band edges; a second objector from another wallet may file while the first objection is pending; PleaLaunch checks the Letterbox's oracle fee settings and hash, and seed waits for the Letterbox and the Tribunal; Tribunal.status counts the seat multiplier; a plea larger than the buy record takes the PLEA-weighted mean of the record's and the received-PLEA facts, to the nearest point; the text checks refuse every Unicode format, variation-selector and default-ignorable character; PLEA a trim cannot take before the seller settles is burned from claims at rebalance; a buy's fee refund comes after its payouts; a Stacker without code falls back to plain-IMD cashback; the seed's dust burn is counted), the two fixes of run 8.5's launch audit (exact share band edges; the seat word's EIP-55 case), the owner's fee raised to 1% (2.25% in all) and the run-8 numbers: the need is recalibrated: the fact score is 0-45 (share of the balance sold at most 20%: 16, at most 35%: 9, more: 3; held 7 days: 7, 3 days: 4, 1 day: 2; at a loss: 13, gain at most 50%: 12, 200%: 10, 500%: 8, 1,000%: 6, more: 4; PLEA no buy record covers: held since trading opened, profit 10; 24h trend up: 9, flat: 5, down: 0), the need is 71 minus the fact score (CannotPass above 45), the judges' 0-45 scale and definitions are unchanged, and a letter pleads 20% of the writer's PLEA. Deploy exactly PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in the listed order, with zero ETH, in one atomic factory transaction. PLEA and PleaDistributor receive $owner; PleaLaunch reads its owner from PLEA and registers the system during construction. Atomic deployment prevents another caller from taking PLEA's deployment-block registration window. CabalGate's arguments specify Intake v2, the oracle fee asset, pool TestIMD, the attestation signer, 18000-second seasons and a 118800-second dead-man. Seasons takes the same pool TestIMD and the seat NFT. PleaLaunch specifies the Sepolia v4 PoolManager, pool TestIMD, Stacker, credit gas 1300000, START 1792335600 (2026-10-18 15:00 UTC), and the same oracle fee asset. The static bool word 1 enables minting Sepolia's test oracle fee. PleaLaunch's 12th and 13th arguments are the keccak256 hashes of the accepted build's argument-free Letterbox and Tribunal creation code. The nonzero Tribunal commitment enables Objection!. Letterbox, Tribunal and PleaHook are present in the accepted source and deployed separately after this five-contract transaction through PleaLaunch's committed-code deployment functions; these are not manifest initialization calls. The hook requires a mined flag-compatible CREATE2 salt. Its deployment mints 82% of PLEA to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor. The distributor's owner sets one Merkle root for the swarm's 10% and the 2% airdrop. Seasons pays the top 25 eligible wallets with at least 60 points, using shareBps for both IMD and the 10000000 PLEA bonus in each of the first six seasons. Trading opens through seed() once the hook, the Letterbox and (the Tribunal hash being nonzero) the Tribunal are deployed: PLEA's owner may call any time; anyone may call from START. Neither seed nor the later deployments are part of this manifest's constructor-only launch.
